decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk line fits the post-pandemic demand for adaptable, representative workplaces and draws on core office competence, so its results likely meet aspirations and give no trigger for search.
The chair family is close to the core offer and cheap to carry with existing craft and distribution resources, although by its fourth year it may be refreshed with newer models.

Floor cushions from carpets are a niche accessory whose uncertain results invite problemistic search, but shared materials with the rug line and slack at a hiring firm still favour keeping them, with a substantial risk of pruning.
The upholstered sofa had only modest visibility, which raises the chance it falls short of aspirations, yet it fits the core living range and costs little to keep.
The high standing table suits the flexible-workplace direction and sits close to the established offer, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
The rug collection is distant from the core but is presented as a flagship of the firm's direction, so management commitment and available slack let it continue despite uncertain results.
